book.name: 1 Tesaronaika
book.title: TESARONAIKA KINA'MI NKISA PORO KAENTIYE (KA YAGANE)

content: Pigoya, uwasuwa puma misanagaba kampa tabuma, tige tigasanaga tabugama, napiyenarempa kanara poga, tasibinto Atenisi kumata mima,

tao'yagara Timoti otauwagana, tasitate tigeti wantiye. Aeba Koti kayokaya'ena puma, Karaisiti mpono yuga pemi ntagarawe. Piya, a'yugu ka'isa tigetisa kina'mi iki naki puma iyekuru pusanaga, aepa otauwagana, tiyo'maema timatiti'ena tonkiya puritanema wantiye. Tigeba ago agantawe. Pi tauki nakiyenaga taeke utaratantiye.
Eya, pai tigege mima taeba maya urimintompene: Aintiba tauki nakiyenaba maekunema, urimintompekana, pigo taeti aboragiri agawe.
Piya pemika, uwasuwa puma misanagaba kampa naboga, timatiti agori abenema, Timoti otauwagana tigeti wantiye. A'yugu amiyo puritakena yagarama ampa tigekara iyekiri, araga yogare kaisanaga untuwe.
Timoti iwaga kamana omogana Poro a'mu puntiye

Pigoya, Timoti titate a'wae puma taeti ibanto kanamagina, timatiti'ena agu kao'enarikabeba aogi awaga kamanati ampa yegi abune. Tige tiganema yokiri, pabiyama tae tagakena pumagiri, taeka asi nasi napiyewema, yegi abune.
We, tao'mitaba, tigeba aogi timatiti puma abeka taeba ago abune. Pi'na esegi puratagi, tauki naki puma taekuruyena pompe'napa asugasune.
Piyama, Wa'egawamati esegima atokaema miyigipa, abima ta'muntanabi mikune.
Taeba tigekaba Kotirempa nkaobi tabera ta'mu puritaune. Pi ta'muntanaba Kotiba pumaeyanoma tamemikawe.
Piya, arape asenabipe taeba esegima nunamu yompepa, tigeti wama tiyowara agakena puma timatiti'ena arosasanaga, pumaema esegi puritanema yune.
Koti esegi puwaitanema Poro nunamu untiye
Pigoya, tabarempa Koti aewake, Wa'ega Isuge, isigewaisi kepa tayakisigi, tigeti wanema, yune.
Pigoya, Wa'egawama agu kao'ena puritaomesa puma, tigeba tiyokina'mitibe a'ya'ma kina'mitibe pabiyama puwaitaiyo.

Piya puwaitaigina, Wa'egawama tigu esegi puritanema yune. Piya puritakiri, aintiba Wa'ega Isurempa Kotiti atokaenta kina'wake tumikibi ntagaba, tigeba tabarempa Koti nkaobi kamana kampa utaritakiri aota mikibewe. Pika nunamu yune.
